notes: Fixed background processes/leftover instances (daemon tray thread, hard process exit, single-instance guard), hotkey labels on Record/Play/Auto-clicker, Play/Stop consolidated into a real toggle, Record/Play/Auto-clicker made properly mutually exclusive, Clear macro + Clear activity + Restart actions, a high-contrast border regression, a Settings-saved toast, and the real root cause of 'can't type in Auto Clicker' (a segmented-button click crash that left fields permanently disabled after switching modes). New: Show mode overlay (Settings > Appearance, applies live). Hardening: replaced the dev-gate password, added size/count/time bounds to .mmac import. Optimizations: dropdown and table widgets no longer rebuild from scratch on every refresh.

Every setting now has a hover tooltip (incl. Auto Clicker). Fixed: the updater's 'unable to close all applications' message, dark-mode cyan/white contrast on segmented buttons, a settings-corruption bug that could wipe a whole settings section over one bad value, the auto-clicker's hold not being instantly cancellable, and the abort safety-net not honoring the scancode setting. New: hotkey-conflict warnings + a Test-hotkey button, pause between repeat/loop passes, Export/Import Everything (one .zip with settings+presets+macros), automatic macro backups on save, and pixel-color-triggered auto-clicking.

Fixed the border that was drawing a 1px outline on every panel (the 'weird lines' and the sidebar-header glitch), equal light/dark theming, high-contrast text on the Record/Stop/Delete buttons, Settings values realigned to the left. Also: the in-app updater now actually quits the app after launching an installer; the recording countdown can be cancelled with Stop/Abort (it silently couldn't before); Send-scancodes and Playback-tail settings now apply live instead of needing a restart; both countdowns cancel instantly instead of after up to 1s; minor hotkey and double-start race fixes.

Left sidebar navigation (top tab bar and menu bar removed; File/Help actions moved to the Version tab). Every dropdown is now scrollable and updates correctly. Mouse wheel over a slider scrolls the page instead of changing the value. A one-line tooltip on every Settings control after a ~1s hover.
Fixes 0.2.0 launching to no window (the redesigned window was created hidden and never shown). Also defaults to the dark theme.

Redesigned UI (CustomTkinter, dark futuristic look), new high-detail icon, and a playback fix: Play now counts down so you can click the target window (the global hotkey plays instantly). Superseded by 0.2.3.

First public beta. Macro recorder/player, built-in auto-clicker, plain-text .mmac format, Manual Maker editor, Saved Macros library, Settings, and a Version tab with in-app updater + Developer sub-tab.
